# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report it privately through GitHub: **Security → Report a vulnerability**
(https://github.com/telamonjs/telamonjs/security/advisories/new), or email
**security@telamonjs.com**. Include:

- the affected package and version,
- a description of the issue and its impact,
- steps or a proof of concept to reproduce it.

You will get an acknowledgement within 3 business days. Once the issue is
confirmed, a fix is prepared privately and released before the details are
made public. Reporters are credited in the release notes unless they prefer
otherwise.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest minor version of each package.
Upgrade within the current major to receive them.
